name: F.I.L.A. - Fabbrica Italiana Lapis ed Affini S.p.A.
summary: FILA - Fabbrica Italiana Lapis ed Affini S.p.A. is an Italian manufacturer and distributor of art supplies, stationery, and writing instruments. The company's product portfolio includes brands such as FILA, Giotto, and Daler-Rowney, offering a wide range of products for artists, students, and professionals. FILA is headquartered in Milan, Italy.
